lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba4Hg2W2O12 (reduced formula Ba2HgWO6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral W centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while Hg adopts a 9-vertex coordination environment and Ba shows a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. Corner-sharing between WO6 octahedra and face-sharing between Ba 12-vertex polyhedra and WO6 octahedra are observed, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity network.
